WBCQ The Planet FAQ

What frequency is WBCQ The Planet on?
In the A-26 season WBCQ The Planet is scheduled on 3 shortwave frequencies, including 3265, 6160, 7490 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 6160 kHz (8 pm – 9 pm Eastern). For Europe: 6160 kHz (5 pm – 1 am UTC+1).

Can I hear WBCQ The Planet in the USA?
Yes. WBCQ The Planet is beamed at North America this season on 3265, 6160, 7490 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 6160 kHz (8 pm – 9 pm Eastern).

Does WBCQ The Planet broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 3265 kHz at 00:00–01:00 UTC to North America; 6160 kHz at 00:00–01:00 UTC to North America; 6160 kHz at 16:00–24h UTC to North America; 7490 kHz at 16:00–04:00 UTC to North America.

Is WBCQ The Planet on the air right now?
As of Friday, September 25, 2026, 10:11 UTC, WBCQ The Planet is not currently scheduled to be broadcasting. Next scheduled transmission is 6160 kHz at 16:00 UTC. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
